response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong full-stack and systems programming experience but lacks direct experience with enterprise Java/Kotlin IDE tooling, JVM internals, or large-scale developer tooling. His background in TypeScript, D, and Node.js is impressive but not aligned with the core requirements of Java/Kotlin IDE development. His contributions to dev tools are limited to MCP, AI-agent infrastructure, and general automation rather than IDE-specific features.
strengths: Strong full-stack and systems programming experience across multiple languages (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, D, C++)
Demonstrated ability to design and maintain complex systems, including IDEs (e.g., NI LabWindows™/CVI) and developer tools
Proven track record in open-source contributions and architectural leadership (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
concerns: No direct experience with enterprise Java/Kotlin IDE development or JVM tooling internals
Limited exposure to Spring ecosystem or enterprise framework integration in an IDE context
Primary experience is in web/mobile/embedded systems rather than developer tooling or IDE subsystems

key_factors.factor: Experience with enterprise frameworks (Spring, Quarkus, etc.)
Direct experience with IDE internals or developer tooling
